tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: The app shell behind every panel - the folder rail and the gutter between panes. Never put text directly on it.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: The main reading surface: message list, thread body, console tables. Body copy on it is `ink`; secondary copy `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces that sit above surface-100 — compose window, menus, dialogs, dashboard cards. Body copy on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Row hover and the selected message row; also chips and table header bands. Body copy on it is `ink`; `ink-muted` still reads.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed fields — search box, quoted-reply block, API key and header panels. Pair with `line` and `ink`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface-100`, `surface-200`, `surface-300` and `surface-inset` in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-100`, `surface-200` and `surface-300` — sender preview lines, field labels, table captions.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on `surface-100` and `surface-200` — timestamps, message counts, placeholder text. The lowest text step; never go quieter.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `ink` fill — the dark toolbar, tooltips, the dark state of a toggle.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only — row separators, card edges, table rules. Not for control borders; use `line-strong`.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning — input, select and checkbox outlines, secondary-button edges. Holds 3:1 on `surface-100` and `surface-200`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The theme colour (teal by default): the primary button fill, the mark's tile, the unread dot, the active folder marker - and nothing else. A screen with three brand-coloured things on it has two too many.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of any `brand` fill or `brand` text link.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for brand emphasis - the selected folder row, the selected message row.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` or `brand-hover` fill; white in light themes, near-black in dark themes (checked at 6.2:1 or better in every theme).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The flap colour (marigold by default): the envelope flap in the mark and the second voice - pinned threads, the storage meter. Never a primary action.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for a pinned row and the track behind the storage meter.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: Trust, and only trust: the stamp panel for "Verified sender", "Arrived encrypted", "Original kept". Green in every theme. Never decorative, never a theme colour, never a button.

tokens.name: seal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a trust badge where a stamp does not fit. Text on it is `seal`.

tokens.name: on-seal
tokens.usage: The tick, lock and words printed on a `seal` stamp panel.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element. Solid, never dashed; holds 3:1 on every surface token in its theme.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Delivered, verified and passing states — SPF/DKIM/DMARC pass, delivery receipts. Sits on the blue side of the axis so it never depends on hue against `danger`.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a delivered or verified badge. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `success` fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Greylisted, deferred, retrying and near-quota states. Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a deferred or near-quota badge. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `warning` fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Bounced, rejected, spam-scored and destructive actions. Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a bounce or spam badge, and for the Junk folder banner. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `danger` fill — the Delete forever button, the reject badge.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral system notices — queued mail, greylist explanations, changelog notes. Text on `surface-100` and `surface-200`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a queued or informational badge. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `info` fill.

tokens.name: label-1
tokens.usage: Slot 1 of the category palette. A tenant names its own categories; Anjal only hands out slots, in this fixed order. The vermillion slot: the dot on a category chip, the folder marker, and series 1 in every chart. Holds 3:1 on `surface-100` and `surface-200` as a mark, and reads as text on them too.

tokens.name: label-1-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a chip carrying a slot-1 category. Text on it is `ink`; the dot beside it is `label-1`.

tokens.name: label-2
tokens.usage: Slot 2. Assigned to the second category a tenant creates — never skipped, never re-ordered. The blue slot: the dot on a category chip, the folder marker, and series 2 in every chart. Holds 3:1 on `surface-100` and `surface-200` as a mark, and reads as text on them too.

tokens.name: label-2-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a chip carrying a slot-2 category. Text on it is `ink`; the dot beside it is `label-2`.

tokens.name: label-3
tokens.usage: Slot 3. The ochre slot: the dot on a category chip, the folder marker, and series 3 in every chart. Holds 3:1 on `surface-100` and `surface-200` as a mark, and reads as text on them too.

tokens.name: label-3-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a chip carrying a slot-3 category. Text on it is `ink`; the dot beside it is `label-3`.

tokens.name: label-4
tokens.usage: Slot 4. The magenta slot: the dot on a category chip, the folder marker, and series 4 in every chart. Holds 3:1 on `surface-100` and `surface-200` as a mark, and reads as text on them too.

tokens.name: label-4-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a chip carrying a slot-4 category. Text on it is `ink`; the dot beside it is `label-4`.

tokens.name: label-5
tokens.usage: Slot 5. The green slot: the dot on a category chip, the folder marker, and series 5 in every chart. Holds 3:1 on `surface-100` and `surface-200` as a mark, and reads as text on them too.

tokens.name: label-5-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a chip carrying a slot-5 category. Text on it is `ink`; the dot beside it is `label-5`.

tokens.name: label-6
tokens.usage: Slot 6. The violet slot: the dot on a category chip, the folder marker, and series 6 in every chart. Holds 3:1 on `surface-100` and `surface-200` as a mark, and reads as text on them too.

tokens.name: label-6-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a chip carrying a slot-6 category. Text on it is `ink`; the dot beside it is `label-6`.

tokens.name: label-7
tokens.usage: Slot 7. The clay slot: the dot on a category chip, the folder marker, and series 7 in every chart. Holds 3:1 on `surface-100` and `surface-200` as a mark, and reads as text on them too.

tokens.name: label-7-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a chip carrying a slot-7 category. Text on it is `ink`; the dot beside it is `label-7`.

tokens.name: label-8
tokens.usage: Slot 8, the last. A ninth category takes `ink-subtle` and the word Other; the palette is never extended or cycled. The teal slot: the dot on a category chip, the folder marker, and series 8 in every chart. Holds 3:1 on `surface-100` and `surface-200` as a mark, and reads as text on them too.

tokens.name: label-8-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a chip carrying a slot-8 category. Text on it is `ink`; the dot beside it is `label-8`.

tokens.name: swatch
tokens.description: The true named colour, shown in Settings > Appearance (D-112).

families.display: "LiPi Sans", "Inter", "Noto Sans Tamil", "Noto Sans Malayalam", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans Gujarati", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "LiPi Sans", "Inter", "Noto Sans Tamil", "Noto Sans Malayalam", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans Gujarati", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: The wordmark and marketing headlines. Never inside the mailbox UI.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Console page titles — Tenants, Domains, Deliverability.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Dashboard card titles and the open message's subject line.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings inside a panel, dialog titles, folder-rail group names.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The default. Message bodies, form fields, read subject lines, table cells.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Sender names in the message list and any emphasised run inside body copy.

styles.name: subject-unread
styles.usage: The subject of an unread message. The one place weight 700 appears in the mailbox.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, chips, category tags and dense console rows.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, attachment sizes, help text under a field. Set in `ink-subtle`.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small all-caps eyebrows over a dashboard metric. Apply text-transform: uppercase yourself; the token carries only the tracking.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: Message-ID, SMTP transcripts, DNS records the admin copies, API request bodies.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Inline code inside a table cell — a queue ID, a bounce code, a DKIM selector.

styles.name: tamil-display
styles.usage: Tamil headings set as live text. Always with lang="ta".

styles.name: tamil-body
styles.usage: Tamil UI strings and message bodies: one step larger and looser than `body`, which Indian scripts need. lang="ta".

spacing.note: A 4px base. Mailbox rows are built from space-2 and space-3; panels from space-4 and space-5.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; chip inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Vertical padding inside a message-list row; gap between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding in a message-list row and a table cell.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside a dashboard card, a dialog and the compose window.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards on the dashboard; padding around a thread body.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between console sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top and bottom of an empty-folder state.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins on the marketing site and the sign-in screen.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Category tags, the unread pill, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, buttons, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Message-list row hover, menu items, the selected folder.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dashboard cards, dialogs, the compose window.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The logo seal tile and the sign-in panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars, count badges, filter chips, the search field.

shadow.note: Anjal separates surfaces with a line first and a shadow second. Only things that float get one.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting elevation for a dashboard card on `surface-100`.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the compose window docked at the corner.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs over the scrim.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled button or menu item; keep the same colours and drop opacity.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: The `ink` scrim behind a modal dialog.
